newsitem.title: USA: NU to briefly trim Seabrook N.H. nuke output.
newsitem.headline: NU to briefly trim Seabrook N.H. nuke output.

text.p: Northeast Utilities will trim output at a 1,164 megawatt nuclear generating plant in Seabrook, N.H., later Wednesday to replace a feedwater pump's power system, a company spokesman said.
"We're doing work on one of the two feedwater pumps. We're changing a backup power unit," he said.
The unit's output will be reduced to approximately 65 percent from 100 percent tonight, and will return to full capacity late Thursday, he said.
Northeast Utilities, the operator of Seabrook, has 39.6 percent in stake in the station. The remaining interests are shared by several New England utilities.
